meta.leakage_policy: Node text and graph topology are unchanged from the static OWASP/ATLAS graph. Only edge weights are changed by split-filtered critic feedback and feedback_weight_alpha linear fusion.

edge_weight_update_policy.formula: feedback_weight = clip(base_weight * exp(eta * clipped_signal), min_weight, max_weight); fused_weight = clip((1 - feedback_weight_alpha) * base_weight + feedback_weight_alpha * feedback_weight, min_weight, max_weight)
